entity.name: Baldwin County Heritage Museum
entity.subtitle: Join Today to Remember Yesterday & Be a Part of Tomorrow!
entity.description: Following a community festival in 1979, a group of citizens who wanted to preserve the farming history of communities in Baldwin County founded BCHM. After opening to the public, we have continued to gain exciting items from local donations. Baldwin County Heritage Museum got non-profit status after locals donated the land. Then, we raised funds, collected items, gathered research, and opened our doors on October 31, 1987. The museum still operates as a 501 (c) (3) non-profit organization with our workforce of volunteers. If you're a history buff looking to find out what life was like for residents of the area years ago, Baldwin County Heritage Museum has a collection of awe-inspiring appliances, farm equipment, and more for you to explore. If you want a glimpse of Baldwin County, AL as it developed, then our heritage museum is the place to go. The mission of the Baldwin County Heritage Museum is to preserve the culture of the farm communities of early Baldwin County through the creation of a home for historically significant buildings, documents, and artifacts from community life. We have collected artifacts and stories from the early farming communities in the area, including tractors, wagons, appliances and clothing. When you walk through our museum, you'll feel like you're stepping back in time. When you have a small group or class of students learning about local farming history, you should schedule a private tour. Our volunteer tour guides can provide a detailed history, answer questions, and guide you through our historic buildings. After enjoying a day of education and history, you can enjoy our beautiful outside picnic space. We also have a collection of historic buildings around Baldwin County that make beautiful venues for weddings and other celebrations.

entity.name: Bon Secour National Wildlife Refuge
entity.subtitle: Alabama's last remaining undisturbed coastal barrier habitat - a natural oasis of wildlands
entity.description: Bon Secour National Wildlife Refuge encompasses some of Alabama's last remaining undisturbed coastal barrier habitat. The name Bon Secour comes from the French meaning "safe harbor," very appropriate considering the sanctuary for native flora and fauna the refuge provides. As the surrounding area becomes increasingly developed, Bon Secour is indeed a natural oasis of wildlands, where wildlife can exist without harm. Bon Secour National Wildlife Refuge was established by Congress in 1980 for the protection of neotropical migratory songbird habitat and threatened and endangered species. Bon Secour represents an important stopover and staging habitat for neotropical migratory songbirds during the fall and spring migration along the Alabama coastline. The refuge consists of approximately 7,000 acres of coastal lands, ranging from constantly changing beach dunes to rolling pine-oak woodlands.

entity.name: Big Lagoon State Park

entity.description: Big Lagoon State Park beckons visitors to enjoy the Real Florida with opportunities to picnic, hike, camp, swim, fish, boat, kayak, standup paddleboard and canoe. Natural communities, ranging from saltwater tidal marshes to pine flatwoods, attract a wide variety of birds, especially during the spring and fall migrations. The park offers swimming, boating, fishing, camping, hiking and paddling. Adventurers can begin or end a 1,515-mile sea kayaking journey on the Florida Circumnavigational Saltwater Paddling Trail around the entire state. The park is a gateway for the Great Florida Birding and Wildlife Trail, serving as a stopover for more than 23 species of wood-warblers and a variety of ducks, sandpipers and black-bellied plovers. A three-story observation tower provides a bird's-eye view of the park's marshes and coastal forests.

entity.name: Flora-Bama Yacht Club

entity.description: The Flora-Bama Yacht Club has become almost as legendary as the bar across the street. Guest and food critics are always amazed at the unique and scrumptious offerings on the menu. When you combine the food with the warm service, fantastic waterfront settings and live music... well it doesn't get any better. Located on the line between Orange Beach and Perdido Key, the Flora-Bama Yacht Club is a "Must Visit Often" location on the coast. At the Flora-Bama Yacht Club we pride ourselves in using fresh local seafood and locally grown ingredients. Our team takes the time to seek out area farms and seafood houses who believe in the same fresh standards. We also participate in the Oyster Shell Recycling Program because we strive to better our local environment. The program will recycle oyster shells from restaurants and get them back into Alabama waters, enhancing oyster production among other benefits. You can come by boat, car, paddleboard, float... as long as you get here. We are known for our original menu items and local seafood. There is something for almost everyone. Our award winning Chefs and the friendly staff make every dining experience fun. We have large outdoor deck and beach area. Relax on our sand and listen to the fantastic music from local and visiting musicians. Nothing like a dinner and Bushwacker at the FBYC. entity.name: Flora-Bama Oyster Bar
entity.subtitle: Island's ONLY true beachfront oyster bar
entity.description: There are many stories about how the most famous beach bar in the country, the Flora-Bama Lounge, became the iconic location it is today. Some of the stories are even true and a few others were thought up on a local bar stool. The truth is that in 1962 the State of Florida gave the State of Alabama two miles of beach front land in return for the construction of the Perdido Pass Bridge. The Tampary family (Father Ted with sons Connie and Tony) decided to build a small bar and package store on the new State Line. The Flora-Bama was originally constructed in 1964, two years after the road was completed. In the early days of the Flora-Bama, the lounge was practically the only thing in the area. As traffic began to increase along the new highway, business grew and the lounge grew to match it with new construction added piecemeal to accommodate the larger crowds. At the time it was established Escambia County, Florida, in which it is located was "wet" while across the line Baldwin County, Alabama, was "dry". The Tamparys created a camaraderie rarely found among people of all ages and walks of life. Joseph Gilchrist purchased the tiny lounge and package store on April 17, 1978, and made live music a daily staple. Joined in 1986, by partner Pat McClellan, together they created calendar events like the "Interstate Mullet Toss" and the "Frank Brown Songwriter's Festival," named after the early, imposing night watchman. In 2009, John McInnis and Cameron Price became co-owners of the Flora-Bama, along with Joe and Pat, to carry it into the next 50 years. Together these four owners have carried on the tradition of making the Country's Best Beach Bar a place where everyone feels comfortable and leaves smiling. Today the live music at the Flora-Bama consist of local favorites to Platinum selling recording artist. The events range from chili cookoffs and fishing rodeos to the Annual Mullet Toss and big beach front concerts. The best part is there is always someone and something different going on at the Flora-Bama every day and you never know who is going to be sitting next to you. The Flora-Bama has five stages for live music and features bands of country, rock, dance and beach music. You can relax in any of the areas and select the entertainment of your choice. If you need a little away time the Flora-Bama has several beach-front bars where you can sip on a famous Bushwacker and enjoy the beautiful sunsets on the water.

entity.description: Florida State Parks is a statewide system comprising 175 state parks and trails offering outdoor activities for all ages and interests. At over 4,000 acres, Tarkiln Bayou Preserve is home to four species of endangered pitcher plants as well as other rare and endangered plant species. The carnivorous white-topped pitcher plant is unique to the Gulf Coast and found only between the Apalachicola and Mississippi rivers. Almost 100 other rare plants and animals depend on the wet prairie habitat, including the alligator snapping turtle, sweet pitcher plant and Chapman's butterwort. Visitors can enjoy picnicking and hiking on nature trails to observe rare plants and animals. The system provides opportunities for camping, boating, fishing, wildlife viewing, educational programs, and cultural experiences across diverse ecosystems throughout Florida.

entity.name: K. Pierre Art
entity.subtitle: Award-winning Contemporary Impressionist - Original Oil Paintings
entity.description: I have always had a passion for art throughout my life. From my first elementary school art show to winning a prestigious art award my senior year of high school, art has been foundational in forming who I am today. While in high school & college, I studied many components of studio and fine art, including photography, figure drawing, print making & design, all of which play a part in the process and composition of my oil paintings today. While I studied art, I didn't choose art as a focus for my early adult life. I spent time traveling and working in orphanages in Jamaica, Thailand, and Peru. I then pursued a Masters Degree in Education, got married, and started a family all while teaching in Elementary Education for over 10 years. My reintroduction to art came in the form of an oil painting class at our local art center. The minute I touched my brush to the canvas, it all came rushing back. All my years of studying art culminated into that moment. Since then, I've never looked back. I have studied under numerous Master Painters whose expertise ranges from European Impressionism to traditional American Landscapes. Through my studies with them, along with my own passion to capture the beauty of God's creation, I have found myself integrating both styles into my work as I find myself continually growing and evolving in my process as a fine artist. I would categorize my body of work as Contemporary Impressionism. Along with my journey as a full-time artist, I am a wife & mother to three kids. I love traveling and being active, especially outside. My family and I currently reside in Gulf Shores, Alabama where I find the majority of my painting inspiration.

entity.name: Kiva Dunes Beach Resort & Golf Course
entity.subtitle: Alabama's highest ranked public golf course combined with luxury beach resort accommodations
entity.description: It was a pretty afternoon at the University of Alabama golf course in Tuscaloosa when undergraduate Jim "Scrappy" Edgemon was playing behind another golfer. Edgemon was standing on a tee 160 yards away waiting for the golfer to complete some precision putting drills on the par-3 16th hole. The distracted golfer finally waved for him to hit up the green, and he did. The green-side golfer recalls thinking, "Man that looks pretty good". It took one hop and started rolling toward the hole, he pulled the pin and it went in for a one. That was his introduction to Scrappy Edgemon. That diligent putter was a young Jerry Pate, a fellow University of Alabama student who went on to win the 1974 U.S. Amateur and the 1976 U.S. Open. Twenty years later, when Edgemon needed an architect to design the golf course at Kiva Dunes, he didn't turn to Fazio, Nicklaus, Dye, or any other top names eager to be associated with the property. He chose Pate. "Jerry Pate has been a winner at everything he's ever done," Edgemon says, "I had seen his work and I knew his passion. I knew when given the best land, he would do the best job. Kiva Dunes is recognized all over the world as one of golf's best and most unique challenges." Pate didn't shy away from the challenge of heading up the design and construction of the course. He knew of the property already, having seen the grounds back in 1985. "I remember thinking at the time, 'Golf architects would kill for this piece of property," Pate says. Today, the Kiva Dunes Golf Course consistently ranks as one of the top courses in the country, and it's all thanks to that one-in-a-million shot and a celebratory handshake between two golf-loving undergrads. Kiva Dunes Resort is located on the Fort Morgan peninsula of Gulf Shores, Alabama. Kiva Dunes presents Alabama's coastal beauty and charm with vacation rentals ranging from beach homes to condos overlooking the 18th green. Each accommodation offers access to the resort's four pools, two restaurants, and over 3,000ft of private beachfront! If golf is your preferred vice, Kiva Dunes Golf Course also provides one of Alabama's highest acclaimed public golf courses – a must-play for golfers of all skill levels, and one of the most dynamic golfing destinations on the Gulf Coast.

entity.name: Pink Pony Pub
entity.subtitle: Gulf Shores' legendary beachfront restaurant and bar - surviving hurricanes since 1956
entity.description: The Pink Pony Pub is a legendary Gulf Shores beachfront restaurant and bar that has been a staple of the area since 1956. Originally part of the Calloway family's Seahorse Cottages in the 1950s, Bruce Mernik's parents, a carpenter by trade, purchased the Seahorse Cottages. When Bruce set to remodel this distinct building into the Pink Pony Pub, we welcomed the change and opened our doors in 1956. Marybelle Mernik, Bruce's mother, gave us our name in keeping with the Seahorse brand. At that time, Gulf Shores was still a small city with few modest homes and fish shacks. We stayed at a neighborhood bar for over a decade, inviting locals and visitors to enjoy our fresh-from-the-ocean menu and drinks. Despite an ordinance by Gulf Shores making it illegal "for any hurricane to enter in the corporate limits of the Town of Gulf Shores, its police jurisdiction, or the air/space above it," 1957's Hurricane Frederic slammed the Gulf Coast, washing away the original Pink Pony and the old wooden pier. The Pink Pony Pub has survived many changes and disasters over the years including Hurricanes Frederic and Ivan, the rise of condo mania, shifting sands with vacationers, and spring breakers hitting the beach. Our not-so-large beachfront restaurant and bar boast an oh-so-defiantly pink exterior with a belly-up-to-the-bar pony painted outside. Think pink of fresh bubble gum or 90 percent of Barbie's wardrobe. We're hard to miss! Our unique restaurant and bar are located directly on Gulf Shores beach, just off the main drag. While the Pink Pony Pub isn't much more extensive than when it began, we still serve Gulf Shores' best food and nightlife. Enjoy soaking up the A/C on a sun break or bask in the sun on the weathered wooden deck that looks out over the surf, and let us serve up some of our favorites at our picnic-style tables under the large beach umbrellas. If you're a sucker for a good sunset, stay out on our patio all night long. Our full menu is served up daily, featuring burgers, fresh-caught Gulf shrimp and oysters, gumbos, buffalo wings, chicken fingers, sandwiches, and more. We serve Gulf shrimp baskets that are fried, grilled, blackened, or steamed, the freshest crab cakes on Gulf Shores, and the best Po'Boys east of New Orleans. Children are always welcome until 9:00 pm!

Sandy Key Condominiums is located on the barrier island of Perdido Key, Florida, away from traffic, in a quiet and secluded area adjacent to the Gulf Islands National Seashore. entity.description:
Brian and Jodi Harsany’s interpretation with this unique restaurant affords local and visitors the opportunity to experience coastal cuisine at its finest. Chef Reed Moody, Executive Chef, loves to cook and this love started him in the kitchen at a young age. He attended Faulkner State and studied Culinary Arts. In his role as Executive Chef he looks forward to continuing Cobalt’s tradition of great food along the Gulf Coast and also expanding our reach with the use of fresh and local ingredients.

His love of Southern cooking puts a spin on Gulf Coast favorites and we are excited to have him here at Cobalt. He enjoys the restaurant business because there’s always something new to learn and he is constantly thinking of ways he can improve.

Chef Jeffrey Palmer, Sous Chef, has been with us since 2018. He became one of our Sous Chefs in 2022. You can indulge in the vibrant world of international cuisines as this Jamaican chef takes you on a flavor-filled adventure! He loves to unleash tantalizing flavors while fearlessly exploring the exotic realms of Caribbean cuisines.

entity.name: The Catch
entity.subtitle: Fresh Seafood. Full Bar. Unbeatable Views. Gulf Coast Vibes.
entity.description: Just steps from the sands of Gulf Shores Public Beach, The Catch Seafood Grill and Bar is where amazing food, unforgettable cocktails, good company, and the sound of the Gulf come together. Whether you're here for a beach day bite, dinner with friends, or a relaxing cocktail at the bar or on our patio during sunset, we're ready to serve something memorable. Located right across from Gulf Shores Public Beach and just minutes from Orange Beach and Foley, we're easy to find and even easier to love. At The Catch, we believe great seafood starts right here at home. Our menu is built around the freshest wild-caught Gulf shrimp and seafood, paired with the bold, comforting flavors the Gulf Coast is known for. Our signature seafood boils are a true Gulf feast piled high with crab legs, Gulf shrimp, mussels, Conecuh sausage, corn on the cob, and red potatoes, all tossed in our bold, house-made garlic butter sauces you won't find anywhere else. Craving something crispy? Try our fried shrimp or fried fish platters, served golden with hushpuppies, creamy coleslaw, and fried okra. Looking for something a little indulgent? Don't miss our Garlic Butter Spiny Lobster or grilled salmon plates, both served with mashed potatoes and fresh grilled veggies. Or dig into guest favorites like the Bayou Crawfish Pasta or our Southern-style crab cakes, packed with Gulf flavor and made to be remembered. Our full bar features a wide selection of signature cocktails, frozen daiquiris, and local favorites perfect for sipping under the sun or catching golden hour by the water. Every drink is crafted with you in mind from bold, refreshing flavors to classic favorites that complement your beach day, lunch, or sunset dinner. Gulf Shores is known for family vacations, reunions, bridal trips, and sporting celebrations, and we've made sure there's room for everyone at The Catch. Stop by solo, bring a meeting of friends, or gather the whole team we're built for every kind of celebration. With spacious indoor dining, a lively full bar area, and breezy patio seating perfect for larger groups, The Catch is the ultimate stop for family meals, group celebrations, or a casual bite after a day at the beach.

entity.name: Wolf Bay Restaurant
entity.subtitle: Serving our community for over 50 years
entity.description: Wolf Bay is a family-owned Gulf Coast tradition known for its high quality fresh seafood & local ambience. Its rich history began as a bait shop nestled in the trees along the beautiful waters of Wolf Bay in Elberta, Alabama in the 1940's. Charlie & Sandra Wrape purchased it in 1973. Through their hard work & determination, they began serving a full menu of delicious seafood recipes – many of which were created by ladies that worked there or lived nearby. Although the restaurant was "off the beaten path," it soon became a favorite among the locals & area visitors alike. On December 7th, 2008 the original lodge was completely destroyed by fire. It has since reopened in two locations – Foley, Alabama and Orange Beach, Alabama. These new locations, with their laid back atmosphere and awesome menu items, have become favorites among both locals and the many visitors to the Alabama Gulf Coast. Wolf Bay is known for being a local seafood tradition, and prides itself in serving high quality, fresh meals in a family-friendly atmosphere. Furthermore, many of the dishes enjoyed today are recipes from the Wrapes' original menu including the seafood gumbo, crab stuffing, stuffed shrimp, stuffed whole flounder and many of our salad dressings. "Thank you for choosing Wolf Bay. I know you have a lot of dining choices. I am honored you chose to dine with us. Because of you, I'm able to carry on the legacy my parents started. They believed that great food requires hard work and attention to detail. As always your seafood is hand battered and cooked to order. Our recipes are from scratch. We hope you enjoy your meal and come back again to be part of the Wolf Bay tradition." —Char Haber

entity.description: The Undertow, nestled at 25025 Canal Rd in Orange Beach, AL, is not just another bar and grill; it's a charming gem that embodies the essence of community dining. As you step inside, the ambiance instantly envelops you in warmth, making it the perfect spot to unwind with friends and family. The scent of grilling burgers and freshly prepared dishes wafts through the air, inviting you to experience a culinary escapade that celebrates comfort food in its finest form. Right away, you'll find a menu that caters to all cravings, boasting local favorites like the Undertow Burger at just $11.25, and for just a dollar more, the irresistible Undertow Cheeseburger. For those with a larger appetite, why not indulge in the Double Cheese Burger for $16.50? Each bite reveals a careful balance of flavors, highlighting a commitment to quality that resonates throughout the establishment. And let's not forget the celebrated Patty Melt and Hamburger Steak, both lauded by patrons for their heartiness and tantalizing taste. But The Undertow isn't merely about satisfying tastiness; it's an experience. Patrons rave about the attentive and friendly staff, making your visit feel personal. The engaging atmosphere, paired with offerings like all-you-can-eat crawfish and royal red shrimp for $19.99 on weekends, transforms a simple meal into an event. Guests like Kelly Rolen have found themselves returning, appreciating the non-touristy vibe that resonates with the locals. It's the kind of place where you can shoot pool and socialize the moments away, creating lasting memories. For those seeking a refreshing beverage, you'll be pleased with an impressive selection of bottled beers, all priced reasonably at $3.50 each. Enjoy classics such as Miller Lite, Blue Moon, or even Cronaria while you bask in the good company and lively music that often fills the air, adding to the overall charm of the experience. In essence, The Undertow isn't just a restaurant—it's a central hub for locals and visitors alike, where delicious food meets camaraderie and entertainment. With every dish, from the Grilled Cheese to the highly-praised Chicken Quesadilla, you can feel the passion that goes into creating a wonderful dining experience. The cook's engagement, as highlighted by patrons like Kaitlin Walling, reflects a genuine dedication to not only serving food but crafting an experience that lingers in the heart long after the last bite. So, whether you're a local or just breaking away from tourist traps, The Undertow promises a taste of home amidst the beauty of Orange Beach.

entity.subtitle: Private dolphin tours, fishing charters & jet ski adventures in Orange Beach, Alabama
entity.description: We spend our time with families and small groups to celebrate life, birthdays, anniversaries, proposals, vacation time, and other very special moments in life through our family boat trips. We see dolphins in the wild up close 85% of the time and we make memories 100% of the time. Joining us on our family boat trips doesn't guarantee seeing dolphins or other amazing wildlife like some companies offer, but it does promise realistic opportunities to create unforgettable memories while we search for dolphins in the wild in subtropical calm back bay waters. We are a small company of friends and family that work, live, go to school, and church together. We live off God's natural blessings and show you amazing places while we play, swim, see dolphins, go tubing, and more. We have served thousands of families over the years with our fishing charters, customizing our time with you to do what you want, at your pace, not ours! We hope to meet y'all soon! We offer unforgettable dolphin tours, fishing charters, jet ski adventures, wave runner excursions, sunset cruises, and special celebration boat tours along the scenic intercoastal waterways of Gulf Shores and Orange Beach, Alabama. Our mission is to help you and your family engage in outdoor exploration and create memories that last a lifetime.

Proudly family-owned and operated since 1987, Mikee's is more than just a restaurant—it's a local tradition. Whether you're craving all-you-can-eat snow crab, a golden-fried seafood platter, or a refreshing Bushwacker from the bar, Mikee's is the spot where locals and visitors come together to eat, laugh, and make memories. The menu is packed with crowd favorites, from perfectly fried shrimp to grilled catch-of-the-day, all seasoned with that unmistakable Gulf Coast flavor.

entity.name: Flora-Bama Lounge and Oyster Bar
entity.subtitle: The World Famous Beach Bar - Live Music 365 Days a Year
entity.description: There are many stories about how the most famous beach bar in the country, the Flora-Bama Lounge, became the iconic location it is today. Some of the stories are even true and a few others were thought up on a local bar stool. The truth is that in 1962 the State of Florida gave the State of Alabama two miles of beach front land in return for the construction of the Perdido Pass Bridge. The Tampary family (Father Ted with sons Connie and Tony) decided to build a small bar and package store on the new State Line. The Flora-Bama was originally constructed in 1964, two years after the road was completed. In the early days of the Flora-Bama, the lounge was practically the only thing in the area. As traffic began to increase along the new highway, business grew and the lounge grew to match it with new construction added piecemeal to accommodate the larger crowds. At the time it was established Escambia County, Florida, in which it is located was "wet" while across the line Baldwin County, Alabama, was "dry". The Tamparys created a camaraderie rarely found among people of all ages and walks of life. Joseph Gilchrist purchased the tiny lounge and package store on April 17, 1978, and made live music a daily staple. Joined in 1986, by partner Pat McClellan, together they created calendar events like the "Interstate Mullet Toss" and the "Frank Brown Songwriter's Festival," named after the early, imposing night watchman. In 2009, John McInnis and Cameron Price became co-owners of the Flora-Bama, along with Joe and Pat, to carry it into the next 50 years. Together these four owners have carried on the tradition of making the Country's Best Beach Bar a place where everyone feels comfortable and leaves smiling. Today the live music at the Flora-Bama consist of local favorites to Platinum selling recording artist. The events range from chili cookoffs and fishing rodeos to the Annual Mullet Toss and big beach front concerts. The best part is there is always someone and something different going on at the Flora-Bama every day and you never know who is going to be sitting next to you.

entity.name: King Neptune's Seafood Restaurant
entity.subtitle: Family-owned for 25 years, King Neptune's is the local's favorite spot to eat.
entity.description: Family-owned for 25 years, King Neptune's Seafood Restaurant is known for fresh Gulf seafood, friendly service, and recipes refined for decades. The kitchen focuses on timing and technique—hand-breading seafood to order, grilling to temperature, and finishing every plate hot and flavorful. Owner Al Sawyer has spent a lifetime honing culinary skills to showcase the delectable fruits of the Gulf. King Neptune's is particularly famous for Royal Red Shrimp, deep-water Gulf shrimp known for their naturally sweet, delicate flavor. The restaurant is family-friendly, welcoming everyone from kids to grandparents, and offers dine-in, takeout, and larger orders for gatherings. The Sawyers have taken home first place at the Food Show in New Orleans, beating out 500 competitors including renowned Chef Paul Prudhomme. King Neptune's has been featured on Bobby Flay's Food Nation, The Travel Channel's Travel Deep in the South, Southern Living magazine, and Travel USA.

entity.name: The Sloop
entity.description: The Sloop Galley and Spirits began as an idea from two local restauranteurs with over 40 years of restaurant experience. The location and timing came together in the summer of 2019. The Sloop prides itself on fresh quality foods made in house and exceptional service. One of the partners, James Gallen, from the Philadelphia area decided to incorporate original Philly cheesesteaks on the menus as they are not offered in the south. The other partner, BR Mock, decorated the establishment with authentic sailing tools, pictures, and memorabilia from his days sailing. The Sloop is a locals eatery and watering hole. We do welcome families and children but please remember that we are a sports bar with great homemade items. We do enjoy our island visitors as well! Due to our size limitation we can only handle seating of 8 or less during peak hours.

entity.name: Orange Beach History Museum
entity.subtitle: Preserving Orange Beach's Native American and fishing heritage
entity.description: The Orange Beach History Museum houses local artifacts and memorabilia relating to Native American and fishing heritage. Originally built in 1910 as a schoolhouse, it has served as a museum since 1995 and was moved to its present location in 1999. Families of early fishermen have donated supplies and collectibles that make visitors mindful of the challenges and achievements in the early days of the fishing industry. The facility underwent renovations completed in December 2023.

entity.name: Flora-Bama Ole River Grill

entity.name: Vacasa - Bluewater Condominiums
entity.subtitle: Professionally managed vacation rentals without hidden fees
entity.description: Vacasa is North America's #1 vacation rental partner, providing expert care to more than 40,000 vacation homes in the most sought-after guest destinations. We're dedicated to providing the most comprehensive care for our homeowners, so they can rent with confidence knowing that our local and national teams are with them every step of the way. Our owners benefit from Vacasa's 360-degree revenue management, which yields more bookings than our competitors in 92% of the markets we serve. Our nightly rates are determined by the industry's fastest and most precise data and forecasting, fueled by billions of data points on guest demand, available properties and even local events and weather. Guests can find our wide range of properties—from tiny houses to resort condos to large, family-friendly homes—in more places guests are looking and booking through our direct partnerships with Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com, as well as exclusive platforms including American Express Select Homes + Retreats and Homes & Villas by Marriott Bonvoy. Owners and guests alike can rest easy upon arrival at a clean, comfortable and well-maintained home each and every stay. From secure e-locks, to 24/7 on-the-ground-support, we're ready to welcome you to your next five-star stay. Vacasa was born around a dining room table. It began in 2009, when our founder struggled to find a property manager that could offer both professional care and strong financial returns for a family vacation home on the Washington coast. He knew there had to be a better way to care for vacation homes and provide guests with an exceptional experience. So he decided to give the vacation rental industry a renovation. The market was ready for a company with a forward-thinking approach—using technology and data to enable local teams to care for homes and guests, while maximizing revenue for homeowners. Vacasa quickly grew from one house on the Washington coast to servicing homes across North America. Today, Vacasa is the leading full-service vacation rental management company in North America.

entity.description: Check out the pristine Gulf Coast beaches, islands, and back bays on a Dolphin Cruise or Sunset Cruise! Let Dolphins Down Under be your boat and dolphin cruise connection today! For your safety and convenience, we supply life jackets for adults and children alike on all our dolphin cruises. Children 8 years of age and under are required by the United States Coast Guard to wear a life jacket. At Dolphins Down Under, safety is our number one priority. Along with safety, your comfort is also important to us. We have a snack and beverage bar, (alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks) for purchase on your cruise. entity.name: Cobalt The Restaurant
entity.subtitle: Fresh Gulf Seafood & Waterfront Dining
entity.description:
Brian and Jodi Harsany’s interpretation with this unique restaurant affords local and visitors the opportunity to experience coastal cuisine at its finest. For over ten years, Cobalt has provided the ultimate in waterfront dining with its unparalleled views, first-rate service and exceptional catering.

Chef Reed Moody, Executive Chef, loves to cook and this love started him in the kitchen at a young age. He attended Faulkner State and studied Culinary Arts. In his role as Executive Chef he looks forward to continuing Cobalt’s tradition of great food along the Gulf Coast and also expanding our reach with the use of fresh and local ingredients.

Chef Nick Norman, Chef de Cuisine, is a Pensacola native and has been with us since 2012. He loves experimenting with Latin cuisine and cultivating these elements into the dishes here at Cobalt. In addition, he loves the challenge of alcohol and food fusion with unique pairings and intense flavor profiles.

Chef Rush Golden, Sous Chef, has been with our family of restaurants for the last nine years, mostly recently at GTs On The Bay. His love of Southern cooking puts a spin on Gulf Coast favorites and we are excited to have him here at Cobalt. He enjoys the restaurant business because there’s always something new to learn and he is constantly thinking of ways he can improve.

Chef Jeffrey Palmer, Sous Chef, has been with us since 2018. He became one of our Sous Chefs in 2022. You can indulge in the vibrant world of international cuisines as this Jamaican chef takes you on a flavor-filled adventure! He loves to unleash tantalizing flavors while fearlessly exploring the exotic realms of Caribbean cuisines.

Happy Pappys Coffee
entity.subtitle: A local, family-owned coffee shop spreading love and happiness throughout the community
entity.description: At Happy Pappys Coffeehouse, every cup of coffee tells a story – and it's our family's story we're proud to share with you. The Papadelias' have always had an infatuation with coffee. Even the kids, Mallorie and Tony, picked up a taste for coffee at an early age. Prior to opening Happy Pappys, Thomas worked for an insurance company that took him to Texas short-term. The initial month of work turned into years! Missing his family as they prayed for his work to bring him home, Thomas was in search of a way to get back home to Gulf Shores. He knew it was time to act on his dream of owning his own business. When Julie, Mallorie, and Tony were in Texas visiting, the family stumbled upon a coffee shop outside of Dallas and was struck with inspiration. Not only was this a place where you can get high-quality coffee, but a space where you feel at home. The vision for Happy Pappys Coffeehouse was born. After 5 years, Thomas was finally able to move back to Gulf Shores. He and Julie sat down and diligently planned their coffee shop, and asked Mallorie and Tony to contribute to the planning. After 3 years of creating a business plan, searching for the right building, expanding their coffee knowledge, and encapsulating their vision for what the community wanted and needed, Happy Pappys Coffeehouse was born. We opened in August of 2019, surviving both Hurricane Sally and the COVID Pandemic in our first year of business. We are blessed and have proudly served our community since then. We knew we wanted to bring a special place to our community. Everyone needs a physical space beyond home and work—a third place. A place found on one's own that brings a sense of belonging, community, and connection from others. Here at Happy Pappy's Coffeehouse, that's exactly what we aim to do for the community we love! We serve others high quality coffee, a delicious light fare of food and pastries, and most importantly, provide our customers with a genuine love, happiness, and belonging. Our story began with a simple appreciation for good coffee — now, we've turned a passion into a place where friends and family can gather, sip, and create memories. We look forward to serving you soon, Be Happy! Mission: Happy Pappys is a local, family-owned coffee shop with a vision to spread love and happiness throughout the community. Our mission is to provide a premium "third place" where patrons can unwind, socialize, and recharge, all while enjoying high-quality coffee and delicious foods. At Happy Pappys, we are dedicated to creating a welcoming space that brings joy in every visit. Be happy!

entity.name: Hope's Cheesecake
entity.subtitle: The Finest Gourmet Cheesecake in Gulf Shores, Alabama
entity.description: In 1996, the Hope's Cheesecake Store was reopened, bringing cheesecake, a Gulf Coast favorite, back to life - including the family recipe perfected by Hope's mother years ago in New York. Today, our kitchen is staffed by bakers with over 30 years of experience. Our cheesecakes are made in small batches with ingredients like fresh whole eggs, Melipone vanilla, pure cane sugar and juice squeezed from fresh lemons. The special crust recipe combines Zwieback toast crumbs, almond meal and graham cracker crumbs. Each cheesecake is baked for two and a half hours in special rotary ovens that maintain consistent temperature and protect the cake from the flame - an innovation we imagine Hope's mother didn't have back in New York. Hope's Cheesecake has been providing a Gulf Coast favorite since 1996. HOPE's is a Gourmet Desserts Bakery staffed by bakers with more than 30 years baking experience. We are dedicated to making the best and most delicious cheesecakes, cupcakes and a variety of other desserts money can buy and delivering them to you "dinner party ready". Our Gourmet cheesecakes with their unique crust are made in small batches with the finest ingredients like Kraft Philadelphia® cream cheese, fresh whole eggs, pure-cane sugar and juice squeezed from fresh lemons. We bake our Gourmet cheesecakes to exacting standards in our Gulf Shores, Alabama Bakery.

Gulf Shores Museum
entity.subtitle: Explore new and permanent exhibits as well as seasonal programs and events. Admission is free to the public.
entity.description: The Gulf Shores Museum offers free admission to the public and features a variety of exhibits exploring the history and culture of Gulf Shores. The museum showcases permanent exhibits including 'Portrait of a Fishing Village' created by residents of the Lagoon Village detailing families who settled along the north side of Little Lagoon during the 19th Century, 'Drawing a Line in the Sand' commemorating the 50th Anniversary Celebration for the City of Gulf Shores in 2007, and 'Hurricanes - What you Need to Know' where guests can learn about hurricanes, their origins, the devastation they create, and how a community rebuilds following a hurricane. The museum also features rotating exhibits and special exhibits that can range from human interest stories to exhibits on loan from various institutions. Programs and events occur throughout the year and vary depending on holiday, event, or demand from the audience.

entity.name: Moe's Original BBQ Orange Beach
entity.subtitle: Alabama-Style BBQ on the Gulf Coast
entity.description: Moe's Original BBQ was founded by Mike Fernandez, Ben Gilbert and Jeff Kennedy. After meeting at the University of Alabama, they instantly became friends and had a mutual interest in all things Southern: BBQ, blues, college football, and whiskey. In 1988, Mike learned to fire roast meats from Tuscaloosa legend Moses Day, whose distinct style makes up Moe's original flavor of BBQ. Eventually the founding partners all relocated to Vail, CO, where each refined their cooking skills. Together, they created something special by using fruit wood to smoke their meats and complementing them with two sauces. A trip to Moe's Original BBQ means a chance to slow down, make connections and enjoy our quality recipes passed down for generations. When you dine at Moe's, you're always the guest. The Moe's Original team takes pride in ensuring that their customers enjoy themselves as much as their meal. Expect to be served top notch BBQ, soulful sides and a beer or bushwacker complemented by a smile and thank you. Today, Moe's Original BBQ has been named in the Top 10 BBQ Chains in America by USA Today and The Daily Meal, one of the fastest growing, emerging restaurant chains by Restaurant Business Magazine, and one of the Top 10 Rib Joints in the U.S. by Relish. The Orange Beach location, in the mid-2000s, was partnered with Mark "Pinto" White to test the BBQ waters of Alabama and it turned out to be a success. Since then, partners Lee Nelson and Matt Lovato joined Mark to keep the beach BBQ joint running smoothly. After an extensive fire in 2020, an Ole Hickory smoking pit was added along with more square footage to make the dining room, bathrooms and kitchen larger. There is now seating for 110, inside and outdoors. Additionally, salads, bushwackers and liquor drinks are available. Guests dining in now receive buzzers while waiting for their orders. Take out customers are texted when orders are ready and can grab them quickly from a designated pick up window. We also feature live music in the backyard when weather permits.

entity.name: Surfside Pizza

entity.description: Surfside Pizza is a locally owned, family-operated restaurant in Orange Beach, Alabama, where quality comes first. We craft our dough and sauce by hand daily, using only the freshest, most flavorful toppings. Unlike the big chains, you won't find frozen crusts or bland ingredients here—just delicious, made-from-scratch pizza you'll love! The new owner, born and raised in Baldwin County and a 30-year resident of Orange Beach, Alabama, first managed this restaurant when it was Chicago's Best Pizza. While it's changed hands a time or two since then, he and his family and friends are bringing back local flavor and hospitality to our beautiful beach community. We make our dough fresh daily and use premium, locally sourced ingredients—no shortcuts, just great flavor in every bite! More than just pizza, Surfside is about community, great service, and a welcoming atmosphere for locals and visitors alike.

entity.name: Carmelo
entity.subtitle: Classic & Innovative Italian Cuisine
entity.description: Welcome to Ristorante Carmelo, where we offer more than just a meal; we invite you on a culinary journey that encapsulates the very essence of Italian flavors and traditions. Tucked away in a charming corner of Orange Beach, AL, our establishment has swiftly become a cherished dining spot, celebrated for its rustic charm, intimate seating, and captivating Italian art and decor. What distinguishes Ristorante Carmelo is our unwavering commitment to authenticity. Our menu is a testament to tradition, with each dish carrying the mark of time-honored recipes passed down through generations. From the cherished family recipes, including signature dishes like Lasagna Carmelo, Spaghetti e Polpette, and Veal Piccata, every bite transports diners to the heart of Italy, evoking memories of flavors that dance on the palate. Authenticity is the cornerstone of our culinary philosophy. At Ristorante Carmelo, we spare no effort in ensuring that each dish reflects the rich flavors and traditions of Italy. We pride ourselves on sourcing only the finest ingredients, prioritizing freshness and quality. From the produce to the meats, cheeses, and olive oil, every component is meticulously selected to capture the true essence of Italian cuisine. Step into Ristorante Carmelo, and you'll find yourself in a warm and inviting atmosphere, reminiscent of a cozy Italian home. The tantalizing aroma of garlic and sauces wafting through the air instantly transports you to a place of familial warmth. It's an atmosphere that embraces each guest, making them feel like they are part of our extended family. The intimate and personal touch at Ristorante Carmelo is evident in the memorable moments shared by our guests. Families from Sicily have expressed their delight at being transported back to their homeland through the diverse flavors they experience. These moments are a testament to an unforgettable dining experience. Beyond the culinary realm, Ristorante Carmelo actively contributes to the local community and supports sustainability. Through close collaboration with purveyors, we work hand in hand to ensure sustainable practices and promote the well-being of the local ecosystem. In the vibrant Italian dining scene of the area, Ristorante Carmelo stands out as a bubbling hub where the world feels connected, united by the infinite strands of pasta. It's a place where authentic flavors, warm hospitality, and a sense of family intertwine, creating an experience that lingers long after the last bite. Whether you are seeking a taste of Italy or a delightful evening filled with warmth and authenticity, Ristorante Carmelo is ready to welcome you with open arms and a menu that promises to transport you to the heart of Italian culinary heritage. "In vino veritas." "In wine, there is truth."

entity.name: Gulf Coast Rental Co
entity.subtitle: Where your stress free vacation begins
entity.description: Sarah and Tater Harris met on a summer's day in Lima, Peru, in 2010. Soon after, they embarked on a journey together to Tater's home state of Alabama, where they instantly fell in love with the charm of Orange Beach—its stunning coastline, incredible dining, and the vibrant, growing community. Five years later, they tied the knot and spent the next nine years traveling and living across the United States. Their adventures took them to places like the Caribbean, Chicago, Illinois, Ann Arbor, Michigan, Northern California, Lake Charles, Louisiana, Chattanooga, Tennessee, and Beaumont, Texas, among others. In 2016, after purchasing their first Polaris Slingshot, they discovered the thrill and freedom of open-air cruising. Wanting to share this exhilarating experience with others, they decided to start a rental business offering Polaris Slingshots, Jeep Wranglers, LSVs, and beach and baby equipment. With a commitment to providing an unforgettable experience, they set their prices to ensure both tourists and locals could enjoy a five-star adventure without breaking the bank. The idea for beach and baby equipment rental came later. While taking a vacation to Hawaii both Sarah and Tater noticed all of the rental companies that provided numerous items to the tourist that visited there. They realized that their own home town where they had kept their permanent address had no such place and was in need of a company that offered high quality beach and baby equipment at a great price. They also added overflow parking for all of the tourist and locals alike that are in need of additional parking in the season as well as the off season. Sarah, Tater and their son Jay are extremely thankful to be able to provide a five-star experience with high quality equipment for everyone to enjoy. They are looking forward to being here for our beloved tourist and amazing locals for years to come.

entity_qna.question: WHAT SHOULD I BRING?
entity_qna.answer:
Just bring your beach-day essentials: Sunscreen, beach towels, cooler with your favorite drinks and snacks, whatever you'd bring for a perfect day on the water!
Want to go a little extra? You're welcome to bring chairs and large coolers, but we recommend renting one of our floating docks that attaches to your boat. It gives you extra room to spread out, float, and tie up with friends.
Pro tip: The chair on your Circle Boat pops right off and works great as a beach chair when you stop at the island. Pretty handy right?

entity_qna.question: DO YOU DELIVER THE CIRCLE BOAT TO ME?
entity_qna.answer:
Most of our guests meet us at one of our launch locations, where we'll have your boat in the water and give you a quick safety rundown before you head out to explore.
You can launch from locations in :
*Orange Beach
*Gulf Shores.
Staying at a water front vacation rental? We may be able to deliver directly to you--as long as your location if in a safe boating area like no-wake zones or lake.
If it's safe, we'll bring the fun straight to your dock. Easy as that!

ORANGE BEACH
Romar Marina

Orange Beach, AL

GALLEY ON THE RIVER (Bon Secur River)
18546 County Road 10
Half -day trips only

entity_qna.question: CAN I USE MY CIRCLE BOAT IN THE GULF?
entity_qna.answer:
That's a hard NO.
Our Circle Boats are designed for calm protected water, not Gulf waves or currents. The Gulf can get rough, and our trolling motors prefer a more relaxed beach vibe.

entity_qna.question: WHERE CAN I RIDE MY CIRCLE BOAT?
entity_qna.answer:
No wake zones are the sweet spot.
Around Orange Beach you'll find gorgeous little islands with white sandy beaches, calm water, and even a few waterfront bars and restaurants you can pull right up to.
We'll give you a waterproof map that shows the best spots to explore, float, beach your boat, and enjoy the day safely. Island hopping+floating with your crew=best beach day ever!

entity_qna.question: HOW CAN I TELL WHERE THE NO-WAKE ZONES ARE?
entity_qna.answer:
Simple: look for the signs.
Also keep an eye on the speed of the boats around you. If everyone is cruising slowly, you're probably in a no-wake zone.
One friendly reminder:
Larger boats under power can't always maneuver quickly, and many are charter boats with professional captains.
So be courteous, stay in the designated  no-wake areas, and keep the  the vibe safe and chill for everyone on the water.

entity_qna.question: DO I NEED A BOATING LICENSE TO OPERAT A CIRCLE BOAT?
entity_qna.answer:
Nope---that's the beauty of it.
*  You must be 21 years old to rent
* Drivers must be at least 14 years old to drive.
These boats are incredibly easy to operate. Just point the motor where you want to go and turn the throttle.
We'll give you a quick safety briefing, and the you're ready to roll!
Seriously--if you can steer a shopping cart you can drive a circle boat!

entity_qna.question: WHAT HAPPENS IF MY BOAT BREAKS DOWN?
entity_qna.answer:
First of all....don't panic. You'll have contact information, and if anything happens we'll come to you.  Often, one of our guides are on the water nearby.
Before every rental, our boats are fully charged 100%. The battery typically last up to 8 hours, depending on current, weight and how much cruising you do.
You can even connect to your battery via Bluetooth in the app to check battery life anytime.
And if you're battery dies there's an anchor onboard to keep your floating paradise right where you are.

entity_qna.question: HOW SAFE ARE CIRCLE BOATS?
entity_qna.answer:
Extremely safe---and ridiculously stable.
You can stand up on them and they won't tip over. They're designed specifically for relaxed, low speed cruising.
Instead of a large engine, they use a small trolling motor with a protective propeller shield, making them safer for swimmers and sandbars.
Follow a few simple rules and you'll have a great day:
* Stay in no-wake zones
* Stay close to the banks as possible to stay out of other boaters way
* Be aware of other boaters
Do that and you're all set for one the safest, easiest, and most fun days you can have on the water.
* Respect the water

entity_qna.question: HOW MANY PEOPLE FIT ON A CIRCLE BOAT?
entity_qna.answer:
One person per boat unless you rent one of our 2-seater Circle Boats, which fits two.
But here's where it gets fun....
If you're coming with a group, you can rent a floating dock and tie up to 4 Circle Boats together. That means everyone can cruise around on their own boat and then link up to float, swim, snack, and hang out like your own little beach party. 🌴
Pro tip: Groups love this setup because everyone gets to drive their own boat and still hang out together on the water. Best of both worlds!

entity_qna.question: WHERE CAN I RIDE MY CIRCLE BOAT?
entity_qna.answer:
No wake zones are the sweet spot.
Around Orange Beach you'll find gorgeous little islands with white sandy beaches, calm water, and even a few waterfront bars and restaurants you can pull right up to.
We'll give you a waterproof map that shows the best spots to explore, float, beach your boat, and enjoy the day safely. Island hopping+floating with your crew=best beach day ever!

entity_qna.question: HOW CAN I TELL WHERE THE NO-WAKE ZONES ARE?
entity_qna.answer:
Simple: look for the signs.
Also keep an eye on the speed of the boats around you. If everyone is cruising slowly, you're probably in a no-wake zone.
One friendly reminder:
Larger boats under power can't always maneuver quickly, and many are charter boats with professional captains.
So be courteous, stay in the designated  no-wake areas, and keep the  the vibe safe and chill for everyone on the water.

entity_qna.question: DO I NEED A BOATING LICENSE TO OPERAT A CIRCLE BOAT?
entity_qna.answer:
Nope---that's the beauty of it.
*  You must be 21 years old to rent
* Drivers must be at least 14 years old to drive.
These boats are incredibly easy to operate. Just point the motor where you want to go and turn the throttle.
We'll give you a quick safety briefing, and the you're ready to roll!
Seriously--if you can steer a shopping cart you can drive a circle boat!

entity_qna.question: WHAT HAPPENS IF MY BOAT BREAKS DOWN?
entity_qna.answer:
First of all....don't panic. You'll have contact information, and if anything happens we'll come to you.  Often, one of our guides are on the water nearby.
Before every rental, our boats are fully charged 100%. The battery typically last up to 8 hours, depending on current, weight and how much cruising you do.
You can even connect to your battery via Bluetooth in the app to check battery life anytime.
And if you're battery dies there's an anchor onboard to keep your floating paradise right where you are.

entity_qna.question: HOW SAFE ARE CIRCLE BOATS?
entity_qna.answer:
Extremely safe---and ridiculously stable.
You can stand up on them and they won't tip over. They're designed specifically for relaxed, low speed cruising.
Instead of a large engine, they use a small trolling motor with a protective propeller shield, making them safer for swimmers and sandbars.
Follow a few simple rules and you'll have a great day:
* Stay in no-wake zones
* Stay close to the banks as possible to stay out of other boaters way
* Be aware of other boaters
Do that and you're all set for one the safest, easiest, and most fun days you can have on the water.
* Respect the water

entity_qna.question: HOW MANY PEOPLE FIT ON A CIRCLE BOAT?
entity_qna.answer:
One person per boat unless you rent one of our 2-seater Circle Boats, which fits two.
But here's where it gets fun....
If you're coming with a group, you can rent a floating dock and tie up to 4 Circle Boats together. That means everyone can cruise around on their own boat and then link up to float, swim, snack, and hang out like your own little beach party. 🌴
Pro tip: Groups love this setup because everyone gets to drive their own boat and still hang out together on the water. Best of both worlds!

entity_qna.question: DO I NEED A BOATING LICENSE TO OPERAT A CIRCLE BOAT?
entity_qna.answer:
Nope---that's the beauty of it.
*  You must be 21 years old to rent
* Drivers must be at least 14 years old to drive.
These boats are incredibly easy to operate. Just point the motor where you want to go and turn the throttle.
We'll give you a quick safety briefing, and the you're ready to roll!
Seriously--if you can steer a shopping cart you can drive a circle boat!

entity_qna.question: WHAT HAPPENS IF MY BOAT BREAKS DOWN?
entity_qna.answer:
First of all....don't panic. You'll have contact information, and if anything happens we'll come to you.  Often, one of our guides are on the water nearby.
Before every rental, our boats are fully charged 100%. The battery typically last up to 8 hours, depending on current, weight and how much cruising you do.
You can even connect to your battery via Bluetooth in the app to check battery life anytime.
And if you're battery dies there's an anchor onboard to keep your floating paradise right where you are.

entity_qna.question: HOW SAFE ARE CIRCLE BOATS?
entity_qna.answer:
Extremely safe---and ridiculously stable.
You can stand up on them and they won't tip over. They're designed specifically for relaxed, low speed cruising.
Instead of a large engine, they use a small trolling motor with a protective propeller shield, making them safer for swimmers and sandbars.
Follow a few simple rules and you'll have a great day:
* Stay in no-wake zones
* Stay close to the banks as possible to stay out of other boaters way
* Be aware of other boaters
Do that and you're all set for one the safest, easiest, and most fun days you can have on the water.
* Respect the water

entity_qna.question: HOW MANY PEOPLE FIT ON A CIRCLE BOAT?
entity_qna.answer:
One person per boat unless you rent one of our 2-seater Circle Boats, which fits two.
But here's where it gets fun....
If you're coming with a group, you can rent a floating dock and tie up to 4 Circle Boats together. That means everyone can cruise around on their own boat and then link up to float, swim, snack, and hang out like your own little beach party. 🌴
Pro tip: Groups love this setup because everyone gets to drive their own boat and still hang out together on the water. Best of both worlds!

entity_qna.question: WHAT SHOULD I BRING?
entity_qna.answer:
Just bring your beach-day essentials: Sunscreen, beach towels, cooler with your favorite drinks and snacks, whatever you'd bring for a perfect day on the water!
Want to go a little extra? You're welcome to bring chairs and large coolers, but we recommend renting one of our floating docks that attaches to your boat. It gives you extra room to spread out, float, and tie up with friends.
Pro tip: The chair on your Circle Boat pops right off and works great as a beach chair when you stop at the island. Pretty handy right?

entity_qna.question: CAN I USE MY CIRCLE BOAT IN THE GULF?
entity_qna.answer:
That's a hard NO.
Our Circle Boats are designed for calm protected water, not Gulf waves or currents. The Gulf can get rough, and our trolling motors prefer a more relaxed beach vibe.

entity_qna.question: DO I NEED A BOATING LICENSE TO OPERAT A CIRCLE BOAT?
entity_qna.answer:
Nope---that's the beauty of it.
*  You must be 21 years old to rent

entity_qna.question: HOW CAN I TELL WHERE THE NO-WAKE ZONES ARE?
entity_qna.answer:
Simple: look for the signs.
Also keep an eye on the speed of the boats around you. If everyone is cruising slowly, you're probably in a no-wake zone.
One friendly reminder:
Larger boats under power can't always maneuver quickly, and many are charter boats with professional captains.
So be courteous, stay in the designated  no-wake areas, and keep the  the vibe safe and chill for everyone on the water.

entity_qna.question: HOW SAFE ARE CIRCLE BOATS?
entity_qna.answer:
Extremely safe---and ridiculously stable.
You can stand up on them and they won't tip over. They're designed specifically for relaxed, low speed cruising.
Instead of a large engine, they use a small trolling motor with a protective propeller shield, making them safer for swimmers and sandbars.
Follow a few simple rules and you'll have a great day:
* Stay in no-wake zones
* Stay close to the banks as possible to stay out of other boaters way
* Be aware of other boaters
Do that and you're all set for one the safest, easiest, and most fun days you can have on the water.
* Respect the water

gcr_directory.about_text: Anchor Bar & Grill is a unique and popular restaurant and pub in Superior, Wisconsin, known for serving the best burgers and fries around. Featured on the TV show Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives, this iconic dive bar offers a variety of homemade burgers and fresh-cut fries at great prices. The walls are covered with nautical memorabilia and artifacts. The restaurant features a game room and outdoor seating. Founded over 20 years ago, it's a must-visit destination in the Superior area.

gcr_directory.about_text: Angry Crab Shack is a casual Cajun/Creole-style seafood restaurant famous for its customizable seafood boils. Think crab, shrimp, crawfish, lobster, and more with bold Asian-Cajun sauces and spice levels. Beyond boils, many locations also offer appetizers, sandwiches, Po'Boys, fried seafood baskets, salads, and non-seafood options like chicken or burgers. Whether you are celebrating a big birthday, a milestone anniversary, or another special occasion, Angry Crab Shack is the place for a one-of-a-kind experience, with multiple locations worldwide. Delicious food, a fun environment, and a team of amazing staff make a visit to Angry Crab Shack memorable for everyone. Bibs are provided to keep shirts clean, but you can get as messy as you want as the tables are covered with paper. Those who do not love seafood can choose from flavorful Po'Boys, delicious cheeseburgers, juicy chicken sandwiches, and more. Angry Crab Shack even offers vegetable and tofu options for vegetarians.

gcr_directory.about_text: The Orange Beach History Museum houses local artifacts and memorabilia relating to Native American and fishing heritage. Originally built in 1910 as a schoolhouse, it has served as a museum since 1995 and was moved to its present location in 1999. Families of early fishermen have donated supplies and collectibles that make visitors mindful of the challenges and achievements in the early days of the fishing industry. The facility underwent renovations completed in December 2023.

gcr_directory.name: Flora-Bama Lounge and Oyster Bar
gcr_directory.hours: {"friday": {"open": "11:00", "close": "2:30", "closed": false}, "monday": {"open": "11:00", "close": "2:30", "closed": false}, "sunday": {"open": "11:00", "close": "2:30", "closed": false}, "tuesday": {"open": "11:00", "close": "2:30", "closed": false}, "saturday": {"open": "11:00", "close": "2:30", "closed": false}, "thursday": {"open": "11:00", "close": "2:30", "closed": false}, "wednesday": {"open": "11:00", "close": "2:30", "closed": false}}
gcr_directory.about_text: There are many stories about how the most famous beach bar in the country, the Flora-Bama Lounge, became the iconic location it is today. Some of the stories are even true and a few others were thought up on a local bar stool. The truth is that in 1962 the State of Florida gave the State of Alabama two miles of beach front land in return for the construction of the Perdido Pass Bridge. The Tampary family (Father Ted with sons Connie and Tony) decided to build a small bar and package store on the new State Line. The Flora-Bama was originally constructed in 1964, two years after the road was completed. In the early days of the Flora-Bama, the lounge was practically the only thing in the area. As traffic began to increase along the new highway, business grew and the lounge grew to match it with new construction added piecemeal to accommodate the larger crowds. At the time it was established Escambia County, Florida, in which it is located was "wet" while across the line Baldwin County, Alabama, was "dry". The Tamparys created a camaraderie rarely found among people of all ages and walks of life. Joseph Gilchrist purchased the tiny lounge and package store on April 17, 1978, and made live music a daily staple. Joined in 1986, by partner Pat McClellan, together they created calendar events like the "Interstate Mullet Toss" and the "Frank Brown Songwriter's Festival," named after the early, imposing night watchman. In 2009, John McInnis and Cameron Price became co-owners of the Flora-Bama, along with Joe and Pat, to carry it into the next 50 years. Together these four owners have carried on the tradition of making the Country's Best Beach Bar a place where everyone feels comfortable and leaves smiling. Today the live music at the Flora-Bama consist of local favorites to Platinum selling recording artist. The events range from chili cookoffs and fishing rodeos to the Annual Mullet Toss and big beach front concerts. The best part is there is always someone and something different going on at the Flora-Bama every day and you never know who is going to be sitting next to you.

gcr_directory.about_text: Since 2004, Southern Rose Parasailing & Dolphin Cruises has been offering the best parasailing adventures in Orange Beach, Gulf Shores and Perdido Key. Whether you are an experienced veteran or this is your first outing, experience the thrill of flying with the best adventure company on Alabama's Gulf Coast. We have the largest fleet of parasail boats in the area, and all of our vessels and crew are U.S. Coast Guard approved. Soar up to 800 feet in the air and admire the views of Alabama's picturesque coastline. Parasailing is available for all ages (3 and up), with double and triple parasailing adventures. We also offer dolphin cruises, jet ski rentals, banana boat rides, boat rentals, and jet ski dolphin tours.

gcr_directory.about_text: Off the beaten path on Canal Road in Orange Beach, Cosmo's Restaurant & Bar is far from ordinary. Culinary greats such as the chicken roulade, the sesame seared tuna salad, and the traditional crab cakes done with a twist will have you wanting more. The Year of Alabama Food named their Banana Leaf Wrapped Fish as one of 'the top 100 dishes to eat before you die.' Happy Hour is served daily 3–5 PM featuring draft beer, house wines, delicious appetizers, $2 off all sushi rolls, and the famous Firecracker Shrimp.

gcr_directory.about_text: The Pink Pony Pub is a legendary beachfront restaurant and bar in Gulf Shores, Alabama, known for its bright pink exterior, gulf-front views, and old-school coastal charm. Originally opened in the 1950s and reborn after multiple hurricanes, the Pink Pony has become a true local landmark where visitors and locals gather for shrimp baskets, raw oysters, burgers, gumbos, and Po' Boys. With a fun, lively atmosphere, full bar, frozen daiquiris, Bushwhackers, and family-friendly dining until 9 PM, the Pink Pony Pub delivers classic beach-bar vibes right on the sand, just steps from the Gulf of Mexico.

gcr_directory.name: Wolf Bay Restaurant
gcr_directory.about_text: Family-owned Gulf Coast landmark since 1973, serving fresh seafood, Southern favorites, Captain's Platters, hand-cut steaks, and famous all-you-can-eat salad bar.

gcr_directory.name: Cactus Cantina Mexican Grill
gcr_directory.about_text: Started by cousins Michael and Bobby in 2011 in McDonough, Georgia. The Gulf Shores location opened in March 2013. Now operates six locations across Alabama, Georgia, and Florida. Known for laid-back Mexican cuisine by the beach.

gcr_directory.about_text: A Specialty Bakery and Party Shoppe has been the go-to destination in Gulf Shores, AL, for those looking to add a touch of sweetness and joy to their celebrations. Our dedication to quality, creativity, and customer satisfaction sets us apart. Making custom cakes that are as beautiful to look at as they are to eat, we're here to ensure your special moments are unforgettable.

gcr_directory.about_text: Mexican restaurant located in Gulf Shores, Alabama offering online ordering with pickup and delivery options.

gcr_directory.about_text: Anchored Coffee House is a welcoming cafe offering locally roasted coffee blends paired with delicious pastries and light fare. Located in Gulf Shores AL, we provide a warm environment where friends gather over cappuccinos or croissants. Our complimentary conference room is perfect for small meetings while soothing Christian tunes set a peaceful tone. Every sip tells our story of community connection and quality craftsmanship.

gcr_directory.name: Bar 45
gcr_directory.about_text: Bar 45 Restaurant and Bar is a local hangout for great food, cold drinks, and a laid-back vibe located at ONE Club. Whether winding down after golf, catching up with friends, or watching the game, it offers classic favorites and tasty bar bites, cold drafts, creative cocktails, and wine. The venue features happy hour specials and weekly entertainment.

gcr_directory.name: Carmelo
gcr_directory.hours: "Mon: 3pm - 9pm · Tue: 3pm - 9pm · Wed: 3pm - 9pm · Thu: 3pm - 9pm · Fri: 3pm - 10pm · Sat: 3pm - 10pm · Sun: 3pm - 9pm"
gcr_directory.about_text: Located in Orange Beach, Alabama is a purveyor of fine Italian dining. Italian hospitality and innovated Italian cuisine that is guaranteed to grow your appetite. Enjoy choosing the perfect wine from our expansive collection to complement your meal as you sit in our dining room that combines contemporary decor with vintage Italian staples.

gcr_directory.name: Cosmo's Restaurant & Bar
gcr_directory.about_text: Off the beaten path on Canal Road in Orange Beach, Cosmo's Restaurant & Bar is far from ordinary. Serving fresh and eclectic food since day one, Cosmo's features a wide range of dining with chef-inspired ingredients including hand-cut steaks, local seafood, and pasta. A neighborhood favorite on the Gulf Coast that has taken cuisine to the cutting edge with variations of local staples.

gcr_directory.name: OSO at Bear Point Harbor
gcr_directory.about_text: OSO at Bear Point Harbor is a coastal cuisine restaurant inspired by vibrant coastlines from Florida to Mexico, offering fresh, locally sourced seafood and inventive dishes with bold seasonings. The restaurant features lively harbor views and a warm, inviting atmosphere designed for unforgettable dining experiences.

gcr_directory.name: The Beach Bun
gcr_directory.about_text: The Beach Bun brings burgers, dogs, and more to Orange Beach! Family-owned, fun, and full of flavor—come grab your new go-to meal.

gcr_directory.name: Wacked Out Weiner Gulf Shores
gcr_directory.about_text: Wacked Out Weiner Gulf Shores opened on March 1, 2018. Owned and operated by Jimmy Williams, originally from East Alabama who made Gulf Shores his home in 2017. The restaurant provides an affordable, fun, and casual dining experience focused on customizable hot dogs and sausages. The business has won several awards including 'Best Hot Dog Joint in Alabama' and prides itself on relationships with customers, community, and local school system.

gcr_directory.name: Crico's Pizza & Subs

gcr_directory.about_text: Crico's Pizza and Subs in Gulf Shores, AL, is a beloved local eatery renowned for its delicious pizzas and mouthwatering subs. Nestled in the heart of Gulf Shores, this cozy establishment offers a welcoming atmosphere where patrons can enjoy freshly prepared meals with friends and family. From traditional pepperoni pizzas to specialty pies loaded with gourmet toppings, Crico's caters to every pizza lover's cravings. Their subs are equally tantalizing, with a variety of options ranging from classic Italian combos to hearty meatball subs. With friendly service and quality ingredients, Crico's Pizza and Subs is a must-visit destination for both locals and tourists craving authentic and satisfying meal on the Alabama Gulf Coast.

Guests can enjoy amazing sunset views from the main and upstairs dining areas, outside decks, and tiki bar. The restaurant features live music every day with hottest local and touring artists entertaining guests. Dine-in and takeout available with online ordering for curbside/dockside pickup.

gcr_directory.about_text: The Bar & Grill at Craft Farms Golf Club overlooks Cotton Creek's 18th green with huge picture windows and a veranda. Perfect for golfers relaxing after their round or casual lunch outings with friends. The chef crafts a variety of regional features and pub fare on a seasonal basis with sharable appetizers.

gcr_directory.name: Crico's Pizza & Subs

Nestled in the heart of Gulf Shores, this cozy establishment offers a welcoming atmosphere where patrons can enjoy freshly prepared meals with friends and family. From traditional pepperoni pizzas to specialty pies loaded with gourmet toppings, Crico's caters to every pizza lover's cravings. Their subs range from classic Italian combos to hearty meatball subs.

gcr_directory.about_text: Award winning DeSoto's Seafood Kitchen features fresh seafood, chicken, pasta, steak, home style sides, salads and sandwiches. Daily lunch specials include seafood, chicken, country fried and hamburger steak, ham with 12 great homemade sides and fresh baked rolls. Dinner menu features exquisite appetizers, seafood prepared fried, broiled, grilled, blackened, steamed, or Cajun style, plus chicken and pasta dishes and Hawaiian Ribeye steak.

gcr_directory.hours: "Mon: 7:00 AM - 4:30 PM · Tue: 7:00 AM - 4:30 PM · Wed: 7:00 AM - 4:30 PM · Thu: 7:00 AM - 4:30 PM · Fri: 7:00 AM - 4:30 PM · Sat: 7:00 AM - 1:00 PM · Sun: Closed"
gcr_directory.about_text: Happy Pappys is a local, family-owned coffee shop founded by the Papadelias family. The business was inspired by a coffee shop the family discovered in Texas and opened in August 2019. They provide a premium third place where patrons can unwind, socialize, and recharge while enjoying high-quality coffee and delicious food. The shop survived Hurricane Sally and the COVID-19 pandemic in its first year of operation.

gcr_directory.about_text: The Cove Bar and Grill is the hottest restaurant in Gulf Shores, delivering bold flavors, cold drinks, and live music in a fun, electric atmosphere. Located just minutes from the beach, The Cove serves up a full menu of fresh, flavorful food from casual bites to hearty meals, with something for every appetite. With indoor and outdoor dining, pool tables, TVs, and a laid-back vibe, The Cove has become a true gathering place where locals and visitors alike come for great eats, great tunes, and unforgettable moments. Live music Monday through Saturday keeps the party going with local musicians and traveling bands filling the stage.

gcr_directory.name: Down South BBQ
gcr_directory.hours: {"friday": {"open": "07:00", "close": "15:00", "closed": false}, "monday": {"closed": true}, "sunday": {"closed": true}, "tuesday": {"closed": true}, "saturday": {"open": "07:00", "close": "15:00", "closed": false}, "thursday": {"open": "07:00", "close": "15:00", "closed": false}, "wednesday": {"closed": true}}
gcr_directory.about_text: Down South Barbecue is located between Foley and Gulf Shores, Alabama, right on the way to the Alabama Beach. We serve the best barbecue on the coast from our family-size umbrella covered tables. Now serving breakfast! Drop by and eat your lunch or supper. After a long drive to the beach, don't worry about cooking! Let Mama relax. Get a complete meal for all your family. Great food at a fair price. We cater for big orders - call ahead so we have time to properly prepare the very best Southern Barbecue for your group!

gcr_directory.name: Sea-N-Suds
gcr_directory.hours: "Mon: Closed · Tue: 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM · Wed: 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM · Thu: 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM · Fri: 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM · Sat: 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM · Sun: 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM"
gcr_directory.about_text: Established in 1975 by Gerald King and David Bodenhamer in an old bait shop on a pier in Gulf Shores, Alabama, Sea-N-Suds is one of the original family-friendly beachfront restaurants in town. The restaurant stretches over the sugar-white sand and sits just a couple of feet away from the Gulf of Mexico, offering true beachfront dining. The original building was destroyed by Hurricane Frederic in 1979 and rebuilt. The restaurant still serves the same seafood using the same recipes passed down for generations, including their famous gumbo recipe from David Bodenhamer's grandmother, Nona Sellers, which has been in the family for over 200 years.

gcr_directory.name: The Tin Top Restaurant & Oyster Bar
gcr_directory.hours: {"friday": {"open": "11:00 AM", "close": "10:00 PM", "closed": false}, "monday": {"open": "11:00 AM", "close": "9:00 PM", "closed": false}, "sunday": {"open": "10:00 AM", "close": "9:00 PM", "closed": false}, "tuesday": {"open": "11:00 AM", "close": "9:00 PM", "closed": false}, "saturday": {"open": "11:00 AM", "close": "10:00 PM", "closed": false}, "thursday": {"open": "11:00 AM", "close": "10:00 PM", "closed": false}, "wednesday": {"open": "11:00 AM", "close": "9:00 PM", "closed": false}}
gcr_directory.about_text: Located in Bon Secour along the Bon Secour River, The Tin Top Restaurant & Oyster Bar has been serving exceptional Gulf seafood and premium aged steaks since 2004. Founded by Bob Hallmark with a passion for cooking and Southern hospitality, Tin Top offers the finest casual dining experience with fresh oysters, Gulf shrimp, Royal Reds, hand-cut steaks, and seasonal house favorites. The restaurant features a relaxed coastal atmosphere with indoor and patio seating, scratch-made dishes, and a thoughtful selection of beers, wines, and cocktails. Known for exceptional ingredients treated with respect and genuine Southern hospitality, Tin Top is a local favorite and coastal dining destination.

gcr_directory.name: El Toro Mexican Restaurant
gcr_directory.about_text: El Toro Mexican Restaurant is a Mexican dining establishment located in Gulf Shores, Alabama, offering traditional Mexican cuisine.

gcr_directory.name: Milkshake Momma

The business is known for Freak Shakes and Southern-style comfort foods. Founded by Sylvia Nolan, the concept has expanded to multiple locations including Columbus, GA and Orange Beach, AL. The company emphasizes community engagement, outstanding customer service, and a family-friendly atmosphere.
