The Alabama Gulf Coast Zoo is home to a richly diverse and decidedly unique population of animals for a small-town community zoo. With 118 species and 22 critically endangered species, every animal has a name and a backstory. The zoo is committed to education, conservation, adventure, and community engagement. Located in Gulf Shores, Alabama, the zoo offers daily keeper presentations, animal adventures, and premium animal experiences.

Anchor Bar & Grill is a unique and popular restaurant and pub in Superior, Wisconsin, known for serving the best burgers and fries around. Featured on the TV show Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives, this iconic dive bar offers a variety of homemade burgers and fresh-cut fries at great prices. The walls are covered with nautical memorabilia and artifacts. The restaurant features a game room and outdoor seating. Founded over 20 years ago, it's a must-visit destination in the Superior area.

Bahama Bob's is a beachside restaurant in Gulf Shores, Alabama, offering fresh seafood, burgers, and classic beach fare. Known for generous portions, crispy fries, excellent service, and a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. A local favorite for lunch and dinner with a cozy, clean dining environment perfect for families and groups.

Amberjack E-bike Rentals offers family-friendly e-bike rentals in Gulf Shores, Alabama with convenient shop pickup and free delivery for 2+ day rentals. Easy to ride electric bikes with access to local trails.
The Sunny Lady runs Dolphin Cruises daily. Family owned and operated, this is an ideal way to enjoy a relaxing 1.5-2...

Angry Crab Shack is a casual Cajun/Creole-style seafood restaurant famous for its customizable seafood boils. Think crab, shrimp, crawfish, lobster, and more with bold Asian-Cajun sauces and spice levels. Beyond boils, many locations also offer appetizers, sandwiches, Po'Boys, fried seafood baskets, salads, and non-seafood options like chicken or burgers. Whether you are celebrating a big birthday, a milestone anniversary, or another special occasion, Angry Crab Shack is the place for a one-of-a-kind experience, with multiple locations worldwide. Delicious food, a fun environment, and a team of amazing staff make a visit to Angry Crab Shack memorable for everyone. Bibs are provided to keep shirts clean, but you can get as messy as you want as the tables are covered with paper. Those who do not love seafood can choose from flavorful Po'Boys, delicious cheeseburgers, juicy chicken sandwiches, and more. Angry Crab Shack even offers vegetable and tofu options for vegetarians.
Big Beach Brewing Company is Alabama's southernmost brewery, located in Gulf Shores, Alabama. The brewery features beer and wine on tap, live music, and events.

Bleus Burger in Gulf Shores, AL, elevates the humble burger to an art form. We specialize in gourmet craft smash burgers, alongside crispy wings, juicy tenders, and inventive sandwiches. Not just a burger joint, we offer vibrant veggie options and fresh salads. Pair your meal with a handcrafted cocktail or explore our selection of fifteen craft beers on tap. It's flavor, elevated. We use 100% FRESH CAB chuck, sourced from Alabama-based, family owned Evans Meats. All burger sauces are made in house daily. Our burgers are 100% fresh, NEVER frozen, premium CAB beef, hand-smashed to order.

Located in Orange Beach, Alabama is a purveyor of fine Italian dining. Italian hospitality and innovated Italian cuisine that is guaranteed to grow your appetite. Enjoy choosing the perfect wine from our expansive collection to complement your meal as you sit in our dining room that combines contemporary decor with vintage Italian staples.

COASTAL Orange Beach provides a waterfront restaurant, an open-air bar, and a lifestyle store all with tremendous beachfront views. Located directly on the sugar white sands, COASTAL offers beachfront breakfast, lunch, and dinner service. The restaurant serves fresh local seafood and unique culinary items from award-winning chefs. The beachside bar features live music, tropical cocktails, and fresh Gulf dishes. COASTAL Store offers apparel, accessories, beach gear, and coastal lifestyle products.

Crico's Pizza and Subs in Gulf Shores, AL, is a beloved local eatery renowned for its delicious pizzas and mouthwatering subs. Nestled in the heart of Gulf Shores, this cozy establishment offers a welcoming atmosphere where patrons can enjoy freshly prepared meals with friends and family. From traditional pepperoni pizzas to specialty pies loaded with gourmet toppings, Crico's caters to every pizza lover's cravings. Their subs are equally tantalizing, with a variety of options ranging from classic Italian combos to hearty meatball subs. With friendly service and quality ingredients, Crico's Pizza and Subs is a must-visit destination for both locals and tourists craving authentic and satisfying meal on the Alabama Gulf Coast.

Award winning DeSoto's Seafood Kitchen, one of Gulf Shores, Alabama's favorite family restaurants features fresh seafood, chicken, pasta, steak, home style sides, salads and sandwiches. Our daily lunch specials include seafood, chicken, country fried and hamburger steak, ham, 12 great homemade sides, and our fabulous fresh baked rolls. Our dinner menu features exquisite appetizers, seafood favorites prepared your way: fried, broiled, grilled, blackened, steamed, or Cajun style, plus chicken and pasta dishes and one great Hawaiian Ribeye steak. Try the fresh catch and have it prepared New Orleans, Mediterranean, Caribbean, or our house favorite Pecan Encrusted Style. We offer an excellent wine choices and homemade desserts to compliment your meal. Voted Best Lunch and Best Dinner 14 Years in a Row. People's Choice winner for Friendliest staff for 5 Years. Located just one block north of the Gulf of Mexico, in the heart of Gulf Shores.

Doc's Seafood Shack & Oyster Bar is an Orange Beach seafood restaurant voted TOP 10 Seafood Shacks in America by Fox News. Serving the very best seafood since 1984, including their world-famous fried shrimp, seafood platters, seafood gumbo, oysters on the half shell, and fresh fish. With 34+ years of experience, Doc and his staff are always cooking up boatloads of fresh Gulf Coast seafood. Build your own seafood platter, enjoy lunch specials, raw oysters, chicken fingers, onion rings, and cold draft beer. Not fancy, but full of charm. Flip-flops are welcome!

Down South Barbecue is located between Foley and Gulf Shores, Alabama, right on the way to the Alabama Beach. We serve the best barbecue on the coast from our family-size umbrella covered tables. Now serving breakfast! Drop by and eat your lunch or supper. After a long drive to the beach, don't worry about cooking! Let Mama relax. Get a complete meal for all your family. Great food at a fair price. We cater for big orders - call ahead so we have time to properly prepare the very best Southern Barbecue for your group!

Bottomed Out Fishing Charters is your trusted name in Gulf Shores deep sea fishing. Captain Ken Tompkins brings years of experience on the Gulf of Mexico, running trips out of Tacky Jacks Fort Morgan on a 30' NauticStar Center Console. Perfect for families, bachelor parties, corporate outings, experienced anglers, or first-timers looking for an unforgettable day on the water.

Off the beaten path on Canal Road in Orange Beach, Cosmo's Restaurant & Bar is far from ordinary. Serving fresh and eclectic food since day one, Cosmo's features a wide range of dining — from hand-cut steaks to local seafood and pasta. Home of the award-winning Banana Leaf Wrapped Fish, named one of the top 100 dishes to eat before you die. Happy Hour daily 3–5 PM featuring draft beer, house wines, appetizers, $2 off all sushi rolls, and the famous Firecracker Shrimp.

Moe's Original BBQ has been named in the Top 10 BBQ Chains in America by USA Today and The Daily Meal, one of the fastest growing, emerging restaurant chains by Restaurant Business Magazine, and one of the Top 10 Rib Joints in the U.S. by Relish. Moe's Original BBQ proudly serves up Alabama-Style Barbeque to customers across the country.
The Only Smart Bar in Orange Beach, Alabama - a unique bar experience offering craft cocktails and upcoming events.

At Gelato Joe's, we believe every meal should be a celebration of life, love, and laughter. We bring the vibrant flavors of Italy to your table, combining authentic recipes, fresh ingredients, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Whether you're here for our homemade gelato, hearty Italian dishes, or a night of fun on The Deck, every visit promises delicious memories and good times. Authentic Italian flavors in every bite, savor the richness of handcrafted recipes passed down through generations. From creamy gelato to hearty pastas, our dishes embody Italy's timeless culinary traditions. Innovative twists on classic recipes blend tradition and creativity with dishes that stay true to Italian roots while embracing modern flavors.

Established in 2003 by Freddie and Pat Peninger, Gulf Island Grill is known for its unique tropical flavors and world famous smoked ribs! We provide dine-in or carry out. From snowbirds to spring breakers, we guarantee you'll be satisfied. Fresh seafood and savory burgers served everyday. Our drink menu has a variety of tropical cocktails, creamy bushwackers, and local craft beers to choose from!

Happy Harbor is the largest watersports rental company in Orange Beach, AL! In business since 2007, we are a family owned and operated company that has been providing fun on the water for over 18 years. We pride ourselves on our family friendly atmosphere and helpful crew, as well as the cleanest and best maintained inventory in the business. We have over 50 vessels to choose from, including double and single deck pontoons for the whole family, center consoles to cruise around the waterways, jet skis to feed your need for speed, or paddle sports for a more relaxing excursion.

Happy Harbor is the largest watersports company in Orange Beach with two convenient locations. We offer a great atmosphere for families to enjoy water activities with friendly, clean, and fast service. Choose from our huge selection of family fun double-decker pontoons with slides, waverunners, center consoles, kayaks and more. Whether you have a need for speed or would like to cruise on the water for the day, we have it all. Get your happy on at Happy Harbor Marina!

Hurricane Grill & Wings works hard to bring you that easy-going, beach lifestyle in totally relaxed restaurant form. With quality sourced, award-winning wings and a bar side atmosphere overflowing with beers, we've created a place for regulars and visitors, friends and families alike.

Island Wing Company is a full-service casual dining restaurant and bar specializing in crispy chicken wings and tenders served alongside eclectic takes on burgers, tacos, mac and cheese and more. With a lively atmosphere perfect for friends and family, we offer an extensive menu of food and drinks including a large draft beer list, frozen drinks, and cocktails. Enjoy Island Time while watching the latest game, enjoying live music, or catching up with loved ones.

Jesse's Restaurant offers a comfortable and inviting atmosphere that is perfect for a casual fine dining experience. Their menu features flavorful and innovative dishes that are created with fresh, locally sourced ingredients, as well as hand-crafted cocktails and a diverse selection of wines. Jesse's is committed to providing exceptional, personalized service and an unparalleled dining experience that keep their customers coming back for more. Whether you are celebrating a special occasion or simply looking to enjoy a delicious meal with friends and family, Jesse's Restaurant is the perfect destination for a memorable dining experience.

Family-owned for 25 years, King Neptune's Seafood Restaurant is known for fresh Gulf seafood, friendly service, and recipes refined for decades. The kitchen focuses on timing and technique—hand-breading seafood to order, grilling to temperature, and finishing every plate hot and flavorful. Owner Al Sawyer has spent a lifetime honing culinary skills to showcase the delectable fruits of the Gulf. King Neptune's is particularly famous for Royal Red Shrimp, deep-water Gulf shrimp known for their naturally sweet, delicate flavor. The restaurant is family-friendly, welcoming everyone from kids to grandparents, and offers dine-in, takeout, and larger orders for gatherings. The Sawyers have taken home first place at the Food Show in New Orleans, beating out 500 competitors including renowned Chef Paul Prudhomme. King Neptune's has been featured on Bobby Flay's Food Nation, The Travel Channel's Travel Deep in the South, Southern Living magazine, and Travel USA.

Upon entering Kitty's Kafe, locals and visitors alike are greeted by a warm, friendly, casual family atmosphere. Whether joining us for a Southern Style Country Breakfast, enjoying one of our many delicious lunch items, or one of our scrumptious entrees, our food is prepared daily from the freshest ingredients. We invite you to dine with us, and enjoy a cocktail from our full service bar.

Gulf State Park is a 6,150-acre state park featuring beach pavilions, nature center, swimming pool, Lake Shelby day-use area with kayaking and canoeing, fishing and education pier, backcountry biking trails, butterfly garden, learning campus, interpretive center, hiking trails, geocaching, paddle sports, and more. The park offers accommodations including The Lodge at Gulf State Park (Hilton Hotel), lakeside cabins, woods cabins, eagle cottages, improved 496-site campground with full hookups, primitive camping, and glamping sites.
We are a Mediterranean restaurant featuring casual quick service classics. Offering drive through pickup with a small outside patio.

GTs On The Bay sits overlooking Wolf Bay on Canal Road in the heart of Orange Beach. With stunning views and bay front dining, GTs features a diverse and one-of-a-kind menu. Guests can savor unique culinary choices and a blend of local favorites, in addition to special creations with a family friendly atmosphere. Enjoy a stone hearth pizza oven and fresh made salad bar as well as craft beers and daily happy hour.

For over 35 years, Mikee's Seafood has been a Gulf Shores staple, serving up fresh, Southern-style seafood with a warm, family-friendly atmosphere. Proudly family-owned and operated since 1987, Mikee's is more than just a restaurant—it's a local tradition. Whether you're craving all-you-can-eat snow crab, a golden-fried seafood platter, or a refreshing Bushwacker from the bar, Mikee's is the spot where locals and visitors come together to eat, laugh, and make memories. The menu is packed with crowd favorites, from perfectly fried shrimp to grilled catch-of-the-day, all seasoned with that unmistakable Gulf Coast flavor.

The Orange Beach History Museum houses local artifacts and memorabilia relating to Native American and fishing heritage. Originally built in 1910 as a schoolhouse, it has served as a museum since 1995 and was moved to its present location in 1999. Families of early fishermen have donated supplies and collectibles that make visitors mindful of the challenges and achievements in the early days of the fishing industry. The facility underwent renovations completed in December 2023.

OSO at Bear Point Harbor is a waterfront restaurant serving lunch and dinner with a full menu featuring seafood, burgers, steaks and more. Guests can enjoy amazing sunset views from the main and upstairs dining areas, outside decks, and tiki bar. The restaurant features live music every day with hottest local and touring artists entertaining guests. Dine-in and takeout available with online ordering for curbside/dockside pickup.

Pelican Grill is located at the SanRoc Cay Marina in Orange Beach, Alabama, offering an unforgettable dining experience with exquisite Gulf Coast cuisine. The restaurant features family-friendly dining with fresh seafood specialties including charbroiled oysters, grouper, snow crab legs, and shrimp dishes. The Tipsy Pelican Oyster and Daiquiri Patio Bar offers live music. Customers can dine in, take out, or even bring their own catch to be prepared. The restaurant prides itself on warm hospitality and a vibrant atmosphere perfect for family gatherings, special occasions, or casual nights out.

Hey there, sugar—welcome to Sunliner Diner! We're so glad you rolled in. Around here, we believe in slowing things down, turning up the jukebox, and making every meal feel like a celebration. From chrome booths and creamy milkshakes to breakfast all day and burgers that'll make your heart sing, we've packed a whole lot of joy into every corner of this 1950s dream. Whether you're sharing pancakes with your little ones or catching up with old friends over a slice of pie, Sunliner is all about togetherness, nostalgia, and the kind of comfort that never goes out of style. So hop in, baby—your table's ready, the coffee's hot, and there's always room for a little more sweetness in your day. We're so happy you're here. The Sunliner Diner Family

Family-owned since 1975, Sea-N-Suds is one of the original family-friendly restaurants in Gulf Shores, AL. Founded by David Bodenhamer and Gerald King, the restaurant stretches over sugar-white sand just a couple of feet from the waters of the Gulf of Mexico. They offer true beachfront dining with views of Alabama sunsets and the sounds of waves. The restaurant features an outside deck for outdoor dining.

The Original Oyster House is the best oyster bar & seafood restaurant in Gulf Shores & Mobile, AL. Known for hand-shucked raw, charbroiled and baked oysters, the Original Oyster House is legendary for fresh Gulf seafood, Southern hospitality and spectacular waterfront views. With vintage seafood house charm, the restaurant offers award-winning gumbo, alligator, crab claws, fish, shrimp, crawfish, burgers, po'boys and create-your-own seafood platters. Features include a fantastic salad bar, over-the-top cheesy grits, and homemade key lime or chocolate chip peanut butter pies. The restaurant is sustainable-focused, being the first in Alabama to recycle oyster shells through the AL Coastal Foundation and the only local restaurant to 'oyster garden' or grow stocker oysters for reef restoration.

The Shipp family returns to Orange Beach with two distinct culinary experiences: dockside seafood and sushi on the lower deck and Chef Matt's signature dishes with craft cocktails on the upscale yet relaxed upper deck. Experience fresh seafood, tender steaks, and exquisite sushi with breathtaking views of Orange Beach Marina. Choose between casual counter service on the Lower Deck or family-friendly full-service dining on the Upper Deck.

Rotolo's Pizzeria uses only the freshest ingredients! We make our original dough fresh daily at each location. Combine that with our homemade sauces and freshly prepared vegetables, and you have a recipe for a delicious meal! We're bringing in a slew of draft beer options so every local can enjoy their favorites. And we're doing it all in a cool atmosphere that you'll look forward to visiting time and again. Honoring our roots by exploring scratch kitchen creations and even better versions of the authentic recipes that our customers know and love.

Since 2004, Southern Rose Parasailing & Dolphin Cruises has been offering the best parasailing adventures in Orange Beach, Gulf Shores and Perdido Key. Whether you are an experienced veteran or this is your first outing, experience the thrill of flying with the best adventure company on Alabama's Gulf Coast. We have the largest fleet of parasail boats in the area, and all of our vessels and crew are U.S. Coast Guard approved. Soar up to 800 feet in the air and admire the views of Alabama's picturesque coastline. Parasailing is available for all ages (3 and up), with double and triple parasailing adventures. We also offer dolphin cruises, jet ski rentals, banana boat rides, boat rentals, and jet ski dolphin tours.

Papa Rocco's is a casual dining restaurant in Gulf Shores, AL famous for award-winning pizzas, fresh local oysters, and baked buffalo wings. We're consistently voted the People's Choice Best Pizza and have won the People's Choice Award for Best Raw Oysters fifteen years running in Gulf Shores. We feature live music every day with the best local artists performing nightly. Perfect for gameday meals, happy hour, and special occasions.

Southern Shores Coffee is a family-owned local coffee roaster and coffee shop located in Gulf Shores, Alabama, known for our signature Bushwacker Coffee, crafted with passion and precision. We're a cozy spot where locals and tourists alike can enjoy freshly roasted coffee and warm hospitality. Our second location, Southern Shores Eats & Drinks, is in Historic Downtown Foley, Alabama, offering hearty breakfast and lunch, brunch options, signature drinks, mimosas, and Bloody Marys. Our full breakfast menu, buffet, and mouthwatering lunch favorites include sandwiches and thin-crust tavern pizzas. There are many stories about how the most famous beach bar in the country, the Flora-Bama Lounge, became the iconic location it is today. Some of the stories are even true and a few others were thought up on a local bar stool. The truth is that in 1962 the State of Florida gave the State of Alabama two miles of beach front land in return for the construction of the Perdido Pass Bridge. The Tampary family (Father Ted with sons Connie and Tony) decided to build a small bar and package store on the new State Line. The Flora-Bama was originally constructed in 1964, two years after the road was completed. In the early days of the Flora-Bama, the lounge was practically the only thing in the area. As traffic began to increase along the new highway, business grew and the lounge grew to match it with new construction added piecemeal to accommodate the larger crowds. At the time it was established Escambia County, Florida, in which it is located was "wet" while across the line Baldwin County, Alabama, was "dry". The Tamparys created a camaraderie rarely found among people of all ages and walks of life. Joseph Gilchrist purchased the tiny lounge and package store on April 17, 1978, and made live music a daily staple. Joined in 1986, by partner Pat McClellan, together they created calendar events like the "Interstate Mullet Toss" and the "Frank Brown Songwriter's Festival," named after the early, imposing night watchman. In 2009, John McInnis and Cameron Price became co-owners of the Flora-Bama, along with Joe and Pat, to carry it into the next 50 years. Together these four owners have carried on the tradition of making the Country's Best Beach Bar a place where everyone feels comfortable and leaves smiling. Today the live music at the Flora-Bama consist of local favorites to Platinum selling recording artist. The events range from chili cookoffs and fishing rodeos to the Annual Mullet Toss and big beach front concerts. The best part is there is always someone and something different going on at the Flora-Bama every day and you never know who is going to be sitting next to you.

site_content.about_text: Anchor Bar & Grill is a unique and popular restaurant and pub in Superior, Wisconsin, known for serving the best burgers and fries around. site_content.about_text: Angry Crab Shack is a casual Cajun/Creole-style seafood restaurant famous for its customizable seafood boils. Think crab, shrimp, crawfish, lobster, and more with bold Asian-Cajun sauces and spice levels. Beyond boils, many locations also offer appetizers, sandwiches, Po'Boys, fried seafood baskets, salads, and non-seafood options like chicken or burgers. site_content.hero_text: The World Famous Beach Bar - Live Music 365 Days a Year
site_content.about_text: There are many stories about how the most famous beach bar in the country, the Flora-Bama Lounge, became the iconic location it is today. Some of the stories are even true and a few others were thought up on a local bar stool. The truth is that in 1962 the State of Florida gave the State of Alabama two miles of beach front land in return for the construction of the Perdido Pass Bridge. The Tampary family (Father Ted with sons Connie and Tony) decided to build a small bar and package store on the new State Line. The Flora-Bama was originally constructed in 1964, two years after the road was completed. In the early days of the Flora-Bama, the lounge was practically the only thing in the area. As traffic began to increase along the new highway, business grew and the lounge grew to match it with new construction added piecemeal to accommodate the larger crowds. At the time it was established Escambia County, Florida, in which it is located was "wet" while across the line Baldwin County, Alabama, was "dry". The Tamparys created a camaraderie rarely found among people of all ages and walks of life. Joseph Gilchrist purchased the tiny lounge and package store on April 17, 1978, and made live music a daily staple. Joined in 1986, by partner Pat McClellan, together they created calendar events like the "Interstate Mullet Toss" and the "Frank Brown Songwriter's Festival," named after the early, imposing night watchman. In 2009, John McInnis and Cameron Price became co-owners of the Flora-Bama, along with Joe and Pat, to carry it into the next 50 years. Together these four owners have carried on the tradition of making the Country's Best Beach Bar a place where everyone feels comfortable and leaves smiling. Today the live music at the Flora-Bama consist of local favorites to Platinum selling recording artist. The events range from chili cookoffs and fishing rodeos to the Annual Mullet Toss and big beach front concerts. The best part is there is always someone and something different going on at the Flora-Bama every day and you never know who is going to be sitting next to you.
site_content.hours_note: Main bar hours 11am-2:30am daily. Gift shop 9am-2:30am daily. Oyster Bar Sun-Thu 11am-11pm, Fri-Sat 11am-1am. Open 365 days a year.

site_content.hero_text: Top Rated Deep Sea & Nearshore Fishing
site_content.about_text: Kraken Reels Charter Services delivers the best deep sea fishing experience out of Orange Beach, Alabama. Led by Captain Jon Ray and his experienced crew, every trip is a fishing adventure tailored to your needs — from family-friendly nearshore runs to adrenaline-filled offshore expeditions. Operating out of Reel Surprise Marina in Orange Beach, Kraken Reels runs a 47-foot Sports Fisherman and a 30-foot Robalo Center Console, both equipped with state-of-the-art electronics, federal permits, and everything you need for a trophy day on the water. site_content.hero_text: Simply Southern Seafood
site_content.about_text: The Original Oyster House is the best oyster bar & seafood restaurant in Gulf Shores & Mobile, AL. Known for hand-shucked raw, charbroiled and baked oysters, the Original Oyster House is legendary for fresh Gulf seafood, Southern hospitality and spectacular waterfront views. With vintage seafood house charm, the restaurant offers award-winning gumbo, alligator, crab claws, fish, shrimp, crawfish, burgers, po'boys and create-your-own seafood platters. Features include a fantastic salad bar, over-the-top cheesy grits, and homemade key lime or chocolate chip peanut butter pies. The restaurant is sustainable-focused, being the first in Alabama to recycle oyster shells through the AL Coastal Foundation and the only local restaurant to 'oyster garden' or grow stocker oysters for reef restoration.

Combine that with our homemade sauces and freshly prepared vegetables, and you have a recipe for a delicious meal! We're bringing in a slew of draft beer options so every local can enjoy their favorites. And we're doing it all in a cool atmosphere that you'll look forward to visiting time and again. Honoring our roots by exploring scratch kitchen creations and even better versions of the authentic recipes that our customers know and love.

site_content.about_text: Since 2004, Southern Rose Parasailing & Dolphin Cruises has been offering the best parasailing adventures in Orange Beach, Gulf Shores and Perdido Key. Whether you are an experienced veteran or this is your first outing, experience the thrill of flying with the best adventure company on Alabama's Gulf Coast. We have the largest fleet of parasail boats in the area, and all of our vessels and crew are U.S. Coast Guard approved. site_content.about_text: Established in 1975 by Gerald King and David Bodenhamer in an old bait shop on a pier in Gulf Shores, Alabama, Sea-N-Suds is one of the original family-friendly beachfront restaurants in town. The restaurant stretches over the sugar-white sand and sits just a couple of feet away from the Gulf of Mexico, offering true beachfront dining. The original building was destroyed by Hurricane Frederic in 1979 and rebuilt. The restaurant still serves the same seafood using the same recipes passed down for generations, including their famous gumbo recipe from David Bodenhamer's grandmother, Nona Sellers, which has been in the family for over 200 years.

site_content.about_text: Climb aboard with a small group and get ready to fly! You will be safely harnessed in before the boat gently picks up speed, lifting you smoothly into the sky. Soar up to 400 feet above the Gulf of Mexico and take in breathtaking views of sugar-white beaches, crystal-clear turquoise water, marine life, and miles of coastline in every direction. Each flight lasts 8–10 minutes and is available for single, double, or triple riders. It's peaceful, thrilling, and unforgettable. Perfect for first timers and adventure lovers alike!
highlights: Enjoy panoramic views of the Gulf Coast on an Orange Beach: Dockside Parasail experience
Soar up to 400 feet above the Gulf of Mexico with an 8–10-minute flight time
Small group boat experience that is safe and perfect for first timers
Single, double, or triple flights available
restrictions: Participants must be at least 5 years old or older to ride on the boat or parasail.
The combined weight of guests flying must be between 150 and 450 pounds.
Children under 14 years old must be accompanied on the parasail boat by a guest who is 16 years old or older.
For guests under the age of 19, a parent or legal guardian is required to sign a waiver. Guests 19 years of age or older may sign their own waiver.
Electronics and shoes are not permitted on the boat. These items may be safely left with a team member at the beach.
There is a maximum of 2 observers.
This departure location allows guests to step directly onto the vessel. There is a place for guests to leave their wheelchairs/walkers/scooters at the dock during the excursion.

site_content.about_text: The Sunny Lady runs Dolphin Cruises daily from The Wharf in Orange Beach, Alabama. Family owned and operated, this is an ideal way to enjoy a relaxing 1.5–2 hour cruise watching dolphins play in their natural habitat. These boats feature a snack bar, restrooms, and an air-conditioned and heated cabin. Explore the intercoastal waterway where dolphins are plentiful and see marine wildlife up close — a perfect activity for the whole family.
whats_included: Scenic dolphin cruise on the intercoastal waterway
Open decks & climate-controlled cabin access
Onboard snack bar & restrooms
Dolphin & marine wildlife sightings
Knowledgeable captain & crew narration
restrictions: Minimum of 20 paying passengers required to depart.
Passengers ages 7 and under must wear life vests at all times.
Large parties (over 15) must reserve at least 24 hours prior.
Mobility scooters not permitted; power wheelchairs allowed.
Children under 18 must be accompanied by an adult at all times.
Must be 21+ to consume alcoholic beverages.
No smoking, vapes, cigars, or pipes.
No glass items permitted on the boat.

qna.answer:
Just bring your beach-day essentials: Sunscreen, beach towels, cooler with your favorite drinks and snacks, whatever you'd bring for a perfect day on the water!
Want to go a little extra? You're welcome to bring chairs and large coolers, but we recommend renting one of our floating docks that attaches to your boat. It gives you extra room to spread out, float, and tie up with friends.

qna.question: WHAT SHOULD I BRING?

qna.answer:
Most of our guests meet us at one of our launch locations, where we'll have your boat in the water and give you a quick safety rundown before you head out to explore.
You can launch from locations in :
*Orange Beach
*Gulf Shores.
Staying at a water front vacation rental? We may be able to deliver directly to you--as long as your location if in a safe boating area like no-wake zones or lake.
If it's safe, we'll bring the fun straight to your dock. Easy as that!

qna.question: WHERE DO YOU LAUNCH?

qna.answer:
That's a hard NO.
Our Circle Boats are designed for calm protected water, not Gulf waves or currents. The Gulf can get rough, and our trolling motors prefer a more relaxed beach vibe.
qna.question: CAN I USE MY CIRCLE BOAT IN THE GULF?

qna.answer:
No wake zones are the sweet spot.
Around Orange Beach you'll find gorgeous little islands with white sandy beaches, calm water, and even a few waterfront bars and restaurants you can pull right up to.
We'll give you a waterproof map that shows the best spots to explore, float, beach your boat, and enjoy the day safely. Island hopping+floating with your crew=best beach day ever!
qna.question: WHERE CAN I RIDE MY CIRCLE BOAT?

qna.answer:
Simple: look for the signs.
Also keep an eye on the speed of the boats around you. If everyone is cruising slowly, you're probably in a no-wake zone.
One friendly reminder:
Larger boats under power can't always maneuver quickly, and many are charter boats with professional captains.
So be courteous, stay in the designated  no-wake areas, and keep the  the vibe safe and chill for everyone on the water.
qna.question: HOW CAN I TELL WHERE THE NO-WAKE ZONES ARE?

qna.answer:
Nope---that's the beauty of it.
*  You must be 21 years old to rent
* Drivers must be at least 14 years old to drive.
These boats are incredibly easy to operate. Just point the motor where you want to go and turn the throttle.
We'll give you a quick safety briefing, and the you're ready to roll!
Seriously--if you can steer a shopping cart you can drive a circle boat!
qna.question: DO I NEED A BOATING LICENSE TO OPERAT A CIRCLE BOAT?

qna.answer:
First of all....don't panic. You'll have contact information, and if anything happens we'll come to you.  Often, one of our guides are on the water nearby.
Before every rental, our boats are fully charged 100%. The battery typically last up to 8 hours, depending on current, weight and how much cruising you do.
You can even connect to your battery via Bluetooth in the app to check battery life anytime.
And if you're battery dies there's an anchor onboard to keep your floating paradise right where you are.
qna.question: WHAT HAPPENS IF MY BOAT BREAKS DOWN?

qna.answer:
Extremely safe---and ridiculously stable.
You can stand up on them and they won't tip over. They're designed specifically for relaxed, low speed cruising.
Instead of a large engine, they use a small trolling motor with a protective propeller shield, making them safer for swimmers and sandbars.
Follow a few simple rules and you'll have a great day:
* Stay in no-wake zones
* Stay close to the banks as possible to stay out of other boaters way
* Be aware of other boaters
Do that and you're all set for one the safest, easiest, and most fun days you can have on the water.
* Respect the water
qna.question: HOW SAFE ARE CIRCLE BOATS?

qna.answer:
One person per boat unless you rent one of our 2-seater Circle Boats, which fits two.
But here's where it gets fun....
If you're coming with a group, you can rent a floating dock and tie up to 4 Circle Boats together. That means everyone can cruise around on their own boat and then link up to float, swim, snack, and hang out like your own little beach party. 🌴
Pro tip: Groups love this setup because everyone gets to drive their own boat and still hang out together on the water. Best of both worlds!
qna.question: HOW MANY PEOPLE FIT ON A CIRCLE BOAT?
